Headline: Full Stack Engineer
Summary: Hi, my name is Robert, full-stack engineer, speaker and mentor. I started computer science in 2009 and have been developing full-stack applications since 2012. The technologies I'm most familiar with right now are: VueJS, TailwindCSS, NuxtJS, GraphQL, Apollo, NodeJS, Ruby on Rails, Neo4J, Ansible, Serverless, Docker and Kubernetes. I speak at tech meetups and advocate free and open source software. I am also a programming mentor and teach full-stack development courses at university. At work, I value the transfer of knowledge within the team and am often responsible for training new co-workers. I prefer remote work and am open to freelance work and contracts. My current interests are modern Node.js backends (Nest.js), infrastructure as code (Terraform), cross-platform development (React Native, Flutter) and modern compiled languages (Golang, Rust).
